overrideHooks.basis: s4client (for s7rest's GUI area): GuiGraphics.blit(texture, x, y, blitOffset, u, v, w, h, tw, th) is blit(renderType, texture, x, y, u, v, w, h, tw, th, colour) since 1.21.2 -- 1.21.1 hands x, y, blitOffset, w, h on, 1.21.2 x, y, w, h, colour: every argument mapped by what it is (the mechanical hook paired the ints by position and gave the old override the width as its blitOffset). A 1.21.1 override gets blitOffset 0, what 1.21.1's offset-less overloads passed; its super call gets vanilla's render type and colour from the frame (else the GUI texture type and white) at its blitOffset's depth (rt/CbClientBlit)

s4client (for s7rest's GUI area): GuiGraphics.blitSprite(sprite, x, y, blitOffset, w, h) is blitSprite(renderType, sprite, x, y, w, h, colour) since 1.21.2 (1.21.1: x, y, blitOffset, w, h into the sprite draw; 1.21.2: x, y, w, h, colour) -- the same mispairing as blit when paired by position. Mapped by what each is, as for blit (rt/CbClientBlit)
